correctness.rationale: The 15 Petersen graph edges yield a rank-nine lattice-full edge polytope. Exhaustive exact 9-vertex hyperplane witness enumeration in inspected source produces 25 facets and all 5734 faces; 1645 cones nonsimplicial, 4087 simplicial cones with unimodular minors. Independently reconstructed convex hull and facet masks give the same complete face vector and 115 maximal nonsimplicial faces; separate SymPy exact primitive-normal certificates find all 115 unit-rank minors and primitive ±1 ray relations with sign patterns (2,3)×60, (2,4)×45, (3,3)×10. Their saturated toric quotients are 2×3, 2×4, 3×3 rank-one Segre cones, degrees 3,4,6; only balanced 3×3 is Q-Gorenstein. Source group enumeration gives six S5 orbits and 15 singular torus-fixed points.
residual_risks: Independent hull enumerator used floating-point convex hull for candidate faces, with exact source certificate and separate integer ray/minor corroboration; claims about reduced support/generic transverse only.

value.rationale: The fixed Petersen edge-polytope is a canonical 3-regular highly symmetric graph polytope. An exact exhaustive reduced-singularity census, six S5 component orbits, three distinct Segre transverse types and multiplicities is a complete and reusable intrinsic algebraic-geometric invariant, not an arbitrary small polygon count.
